    • showYAxis

      public Sparkline.Builder showYAxis(boolean show)
      Controls whether a Y-axis label is rendered on the left showing the maximum data value. The label column is 4 characters wide. Defaults to false.

      When the sparkline area has only 1 row of height, the label appears on the same row as the bars.

      Parameters:
      show - whether to show the y-axis label
      Returns:
      this builder

    • xLabels

      public Sparkline.Builder xLabels(String... labels)
      Sets the x-axis labels rendered as a single row below the sparkline bars. Labels are distributed evenly across the data range. The last label is right-aligned at its position so it does not overflow the right edge. Requires at least 2 rows of height (1 for bars + 1 for labels).

      Example: xLabels("-60s", "-45s", "-30s", "-15s", "now")

      Parameters:
      labels - the labels, distributed left-to-right
      Returns:
      this builder
